Book & Keyword Input

How scoring works — no black box

Demand 30 — Autocomplete position (1=highest visibility) + result count proxy. ESTIMATED unless DataForSEO volume key set. Never claimed as monthly searches.
Competition 25 — Result count + avg BSR + avg reviews of your competitors. More competitors / lower BSR = lower score.
Differentiation 15 — Specificity (word count) + content-gap TF-IDF vs competitor titles.
Buyer Intent 15 — Commercial tokens (best/buy/workbook/journal/guide/for beginners) + top-3 autocomplete boost.
Profitability 15 — KDP royalty window (70% $2.99-$9.99 else 35% eBook; 60% minus printing paperback/hardcover).
Formula: Demand30+Competition25+Differentiation15+Intent15+Profit15=100. Overall niche = mean of top-10 keywords. Every number carries source + timestamp + status tag (ACTUAL / ESTIMATED / SIMULATED / UNAVAILABLE).

Data Accuracy & Sources

  • ACTUAL Amazon autocomplete suggestions — real shopper type-ahead, directly from completion.{domain}/api/2017/suggestions. Not search volume.
  • ESTIMATED Demand signal 0-100 — heuristic from position + word count. Clearly labeled.
  • ACTUAL BSR, price, rating, reviews, categories — scraped from /dp/{ASIN} when not CAPTCHA-blocked.
  • SIMULATED Google Trends — deterministic seasonal model unless pytrends installed (then ACTUAL via Google).
  • UNAVAILABLE Reverse ASIN — requires DataForSEO API key (optional). UI shows disabled state, not fake data.
